name: self-media-studio
description: A tool-agnostic self-media content studio that carries one topic from brief to publish to review, with human confirmation gates at every irreversible step.

displayDescription.en: Turns a one-line topic into published, reviewed content: brief, strategy, research, platform-native copy, video production, publishing and analytics — holding a confirmation gate before every irreversible step.
displayDescription.zh: 从一句话选题到多平台发布与数据复盘，编排十个模块完成自媒体内容生产闭环，坚持人工确认与证据优先。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我只有一个选题，帮我从创作简报一路做到多平台发布
defaultInitPrompt.en: I only have a topic — take me from content brief all the way to multi-platform publishing

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我给这个账号理一份内容策略：定位、栏目和选题池
quickPrompts.en: Draft a content strategy for this account: positioning, columns and a topic pool

quickPrompts.zh: 视频成片已确认，帮我出抖音、视频号和小红书的发布包
